policy: A category is not complete because infrastructure exists. It is complete only when every scoped AP is dispositioned (remediated, accepted with rationale, or superseded), its acceptance criteria pass, and recorded evidence is current. A dependent category may be audited early but may not be declared complete or activate remediation work until every dependency is complete. Published content is preservation-first: queue disposition never authorizes deletion, consolidation, drafting, archiving, renaming, moving, or bulk rewriting without explicit user approval and per-document evidence. Frontmatter changes are script-only: preview by default, explicit --apply, affected-file reporting, idempotency, and post-change verification are mandatory.

categories.label: AP-D 방법론
closure: Every AP-D item is dispositioned with AP ID, scope, decision, and residual risk.
The remediation workflow rejects work without task-level evidence.

categories.label: AP-R 저장소·운영
closure: Every AP-R item is dispositioned.
CI, dependency, artifact, and rollback evidence are recorded.

categories.label: AP-T 품질·테스트
closure: Every AP-T item is dispositioned.
Required regression and release checks pass.

categories.label: AP-SEC 보안
closure: Every AP-SEC item is dispositioned.
Static-admin, secrets, supply-chain, and production-artifact checks pass.

categories.label: AP-M 메타데이터
closure: Every AP-M item is dispositioned.
Metadata lifecycle decisions are evidence-backed; no bulk verification claims.

categories.label: AP-I 정보구조
closure: Every AP-I item is dispositioned.
Taxonomy and relation decisions are reviewed rather than inferred from paths.

categories.label: AP-L 로컬라이제이션
closure: Every AP-L item is dispositioned.
Locale coverage and terminology decisions are verified.

categories.label: AP-S 검색·SEO
closure: Every AP-S item is dispositioned.
Search, canonical, sitemap, and indexability contracts pass.

categories.label: AP-U UX
closure: Every AP-U item is dispositioned.
Shared and article-level interaction contracts pass.

categories.label: AP-P 성능
closure: Every AP-P item is dispositioned.
Performance budgets and representative production measurements are recorded.

categories.label: AP-O 관측성
closure: Every AP-O item is dispositioned.
Collection policy, privacy boundary, and operational response evidence are recorded.

categories.label: AP-A 콘텐츠
closure: Every AP-A item is dispositioned.
Content decisions have source/evidence or explicit editorial rationale.
Readiness queues are reduced according to an approved batch plan, not bulk-marked.

activationExceptions.authority: User approved deferral because backup and DNS recovery cannot be performed now.
activationExceptions.scope: Allows AP-T quality remediation to activate while the accepted external AP-R recovery risk remains unresolved.
activationExceptions.closureBoundary: AP-R and AP-T cannot be declared complete from this exception.
activationExceptions.reassessmentTrigger: Before a material deployment-platform change, ownership change, or the next planned recovery exercise.
